el.title: KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο — Φυσική ελληνική τυπογραφία με τεχνητή νοημοσύνη
el.description: Το KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο είναι ένα σύνολο δεξιοτήτων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης ανοιχτού κώδικα, υπό προετοιμασία, για τη δημιουργία και τον έλεγχο ελληνικών ιστοτόπων, άρθρων, αναφορών και παρουσιάσεων — με φροντίδα για την αναγνωσιμότητα, τη διάταξη και την ακεραιότητα του πρωτότυπου περιεχομένου.
el.lead: Το KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο είναι ένα σύνολο δεξιοτήτων τεχνητής νοημοσύνης ανοιχτού κώδικα για τη δημιουργία και τον έλεγχο ελληνικών ιστοτόπων, άρθρων, αναφορών και παρουσιάσεων. Ετοιμάζεται γύρω από ό,τι κάνει τα ελληνικά ξεχωριστά: τόνους και διαλυτικά που φέρουν νόημα, κεφαλαία με ελληνικούς κανόνες, ελληνική στίξη και ισορροπία ανάμεσα σε ελληνικά και λατινικά.
concept_h2: αλλά η σωστή μορφή για κάθε μήνυμα
el.concept_body: Κάθε ανάθεση, κάθε κοινό και κάθε μήνυμα είναι διαφορετικά. Το KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο βοηθά την τεχνητή νοημοσύνη να διαμορφώνει την τυπογραφία, τα διαστήματα και την ιεραρχία με βάση το νόημα και τις προτεραιότητες κάθε έργου — αντί να εφαρμόζει το ίδιο πρότυπο παντού. Στα ελληνικά αυτό σημαίνει και να κρίνετε πού εξυπηρετούν τα κεφαλαία και πού διαβάζεται καλύτερα η πεζή γραφή, χωρίς να αλλάζει το πρωτότυπο κείμενο.
el.features_h2: Τέσσερα σημεία που αξίζει να γίνουν σωστά
el.features_deck: Πρακτικές προτεραιότητες για τη δημιουργία και τον έλεγχο ελληνικού περιεχομένου.

features.p: Ο τόνος και τα διαλυτικά φέρουν νόημα (νόμος / νομός, ή / η) και δεν αφαιρούνται για να κερδηθεί χώρος. Τα κεφαλαία ακολουθούν ελληνικούς κανόνες — Μάιος → ΜΑΪΟΣ, το διαζευκτικό ή μένει Ή — ενώ το ερωτηματικό (;), η άνω τελεία (·) και το τελικό ς κρατούν τον ρόλο τους.

Διαμορφώστε τη διάταξη γύρω από την πληροφορία, την προτεραιότητά της και τον στόχο του αναγνώστη. Ελληνικά και λατινικά εξισορροπούνται με βάση το φαινόμενο μέγεθος και την πυκνότητα, όχι με το ίδιο μέγεθος στιγμών.

Προστατέψτε ονόματα, παραθέματα, τόνους, αριθμούς, ημερομηνίες, κωδικούς και το εννοούμενο νόημα. Κρατήστε το πρωτότυπο δίπλα σε κάθε εκδοχή με κεφαλαία και μορφοποιήστε αριθμούς και ημερομηνίες για el-GR ή el-CY (12.345,67 €, 19 Οκτωβρίου 2026). Καταγράψτε τις αλλαγές ως προτάσεις, ποτέ ως σιωπηρές διορθώσεις.

Ελέγξτε το τελικό έργο και οργανώστε τα ζητήματα — χωρίς να αγγίξετε τα αρχεία. Τόνοι που κόβονται, το ύψος της άνω τελείας και η εξαγωγή κειμένου από PDF εξετάζονται χωριστά στο πραγματικό αποτέλεσμα.

el.idea_body: Το KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο δεν επιβάλλει μια έτοιμη εμφάνιση. Δίνει στην τεχνητή νοημοσύνη τη γνώση να προσαρμόζεται σε κάθε μέσο και κάθε ανάθεση. Ο ελληνικός σχεδιασμός δεν έχει μία μόνο όψη: γραμματοσειρές με και χωρίς πατούρες, ειδικά σχεδιασμένα γράμματα και αυστηρά πλέγματα συνυπάρχουν, γι’ αυτό η ανίχνευση ελληνικών δεν υπαγορεύει ποτέ γαλανόλευκη παλέτα ή κλασικά μοτίβα.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο — Natural Greek typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Greek websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Greek websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content. It is being prepared around what makes Greek distinctive: accents and diaeresis that carry meaning, capitals that follow Greek rules, Greek punctuation, and the balance between Greek and Latin.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Greek, that also means judging where all-caps display serves the message and where sentence case reads better, without changing the original text.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Greek content.

features.p: Tonos and dialytika carry meaning (νόμος / νομός, ή / η), so they are never dropped to save space. Capitals follow Greek rules—Μάιος becomes ΜΑΪΟΣ, the disjunctive ή stays Ή—while the question mark (;), the ano teleia (·) and final ς keep their roles.
Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Greek and Latin are balanced by apparent size and density, not by identical point sizes.

Protect names, quotations, accents, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Keep the original beside any uppercase rendering, and format numbers and dates for el-GR or el-CY (12.345,67 €, 19 Οκτωβρίου 2026). Record changes as proposals, never silent edits.
Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Clipped accents, ano teleia height and PDF text extraction are examined separately in the actual output.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Μέτρο doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Greek design has no single look—serif and sans, custom lettering and strict grids sit side by side—so detecting Greek never dictates a blue-and-white palette or classical ornament.

ja.lead: AIとつくるギリシャ語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜Μέτροは、ギリシャ語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。意味を担うアクセント記号、規則に沿った大文字化、ギリシャ語の約物、ラテン文字との混植を軸に準備を進めています。

features.h3: ギリシャ語の文字組み
features.p: トノスとディアリティカは意味を担うため、場所を詰める目的で外しません（νόμος／νομός、ή／η）。大文字化はギリシャ語の規則で行い（Μάιος → ΜΑΪΟΣ、選択の ή は Ή のまま）、疑問符「;」、アノ・テレイア「·」、語末の ς の役割を保ちます。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。ギリシャ文字とラテン文字は、同じポイント数ではなく、見かけの大きさと濃さで釣り合わせます。
名前・引用・アクセント・数値・日時・コード・意味を守ります。大文字で表示しても原文を別に残し、数値と日付は el-GR／el-CY の書式で生成します（12.345,67 €、19 Οκτωβρίου 2026）。変更は提案として記録し、黙って書き換えません。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。アクセントの欠け、アノ・テレイアの高さ、PDFからの文字抽出は、実際の出力で別々に確かめます。

読む体験を組み立てる

nl.lead: KUMIHAN｜Zetwerk is een opensourceverzameling AI-skills voor het maken en controleren van Nederlandstalige websites, artikelen, rapporten en presentaties – met aandacht voor leesbaarheid, opmaak en het behoud van je oorspronkelijke tekst.
concept_h2: maar de juiste vorm voor elke boodschap
nl.concept_body: Elke opdracht, elk publiek en elke boodschap is anders. KUMIHAN｜Zetwerk helpt AI om typografie, witruimte en hiërarchie af te stemmen op de betekenis en de prioriteiten van elk stuk – in plaats van overal hetzelfde sjabloon op toe te passen. In het Nederlands begint dat bij de IJ, samenstellingen, het trema en afbrekingen die de spelling van een woord kunnen veranderen.
nl.features_deck: Praktische aandachtspunten voor het maken en controleren van Nederlandstalige teksten.

features.p: Schrijf IJ aan het begin van een woord met twee hoofdletters (IJsland), houd samenstellingen als langetermijnplanning heel en onderscheid het trema van het koppelteken (poëzie, gala-avond). Afbreken kan de spelling veranderen (beëindigen → be- / eindigen); dat wordt in de echte doelomgeving gecontroleerd, niet aangenomen.
Stem de opmaak af op de informatie, de prioriteit ervan en het doel van de lezer.

Bescherm namen (Van den Bossche), apostrofs (oma’s, ’s Morgens), bedragen (€ 5,00), termijnen (tot en met) en regionale woorden als bankkaart. Leg wijzigingen vast als voorstel, nooit als stille aanpassing.
Controleer afgerond werk en breng aandachtspunten in kaart – zonder de bestanden aan te raken.

features.p: Baca Rumi melalui struktur perkataannya: bezakan awalan di- daripada kata sendi di, kekalkan reka bentuk sebagai dua perkataan dan buku-buku dengan tanda sempangnya, serta beri ruang kepada perkataan berimbuhan yang panjang tanpa memecahkannya sesuka hati. It treats Malay on its own terms: distinct from Indonesian, with Malaysian, Singaporean and Bruneian usage kept apart and Jawi handled with care.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Jalin helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. Language, script, region, register, medium and purpose are set separately, so no single “Malay look” is assumed.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Malay content.

features.p: Read Rumi through its word structure: tell the di- prefix from the preposition di, keep reka bentuk as two words and buku-buku with its hyphen, and give long affixed words room instead of breaking them anywhere. Select ms-MY, ms-SG or ms-BN explicitly.
Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Text meant to be read and display copy meant to be seen are designed by different criteria.

Keep Malay distinct from Indonesian; protect names, quotations, numbers and meaning, including kami versus kita and deliberately colloquial words such as tak or Jom. Changes are proposals, never silent edits.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Jawi is checked in stages—preservation, direction and joining, then native proofreading—and nothing unverified is reported as passed.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Jalin doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Rumi alone can carry cultural expression; adding Jawi is not a requirement for local character.

he.title: KUMIHAN｜מקצב — טיפוגרפיה עברית טבעית, בעזרת AI
he.description: KUMIHAN｜מקצב הוא אוסף של מיומנויות AI בקוד פתוח ליצירה ולבדיקה של אתרים, מאמרים, דוחות ומצגות בעברית – תוך הקפדה על נוחות הקריאה, על העימוד ועל שלמות התוכן המקורי. המהדורה נמצאת בהכנה.
he.lead: KUMIHAN｜מקצב הוא אוסף של מיומנויות AI בקוד פתוח ליצירה ולבדיקה של אתרים, מאמרים, דוחות ומצגות בעברית – תוך הקפדה על נוחות הקריאה, על העימוד ועל שלמות התוכן המקורי. הוא נבנה סביב מה שהעברית באמת צריכה: טקסט מימין לשמאל ששזורים בו אנגלית ומספרים, אותיות סופיות וניקוד, סימני פיסוק עבריים וניסוח מגדרי.
he.concept_body: כל בריף, כל קהל וכל מסר שונים זה מזה. KUMIHAN｜מקצב עוזר ל-AI לעצב טיפוגרפיה, ריווח והיררכיה סביב המשמעות וסדרי העדיפויות של כל עבודה – במקום להחיל תבנית אחת על הכול. בעברית זה מתחיל בכיוון: טקסט מיושר לימין עדיין אינו טקסט מימין לשמאל.
he.features_deck: סדרי עדיפויות מעשיים ליצירה ולבדיקה של תוכן בעברית.

features.h3: מימין לשמאל, גם עם לטינית בפנים
features.p: הגדרת שפה וכיוון, עימוד לפי התחלה וסוף לוגיים, ושמירה על שמות באנגלית, מספרי גרסה, כתובות URL ומספרים כמקטעים מבודדים – בלי להפוך תווים ידנית. הבחנה בין גרש, גרשיים ומקף לבין מירכאות, גרש לטיני ומקף לטיני.
בניית העימוד סביב המידע, סדר החשיבות שלו והמטרה של הקוראים. בעברית אין אותיות רישיות, ולכן ההיררכיה נבנית ממשקל, מגודל, מריווח וממיקום – והאיזון בין עברית ללטינית נקבע בעין, לא לפי אותו גודל גופן.

שמירה על שמות, ציטוטים, מספרים, תאריכים, מזהים ועל המשמעות המקורית. אותיות סופיות לא מוחלפות אוטומטית, הניקוד לא נמחק, תווי כיווניות לא נמחקים כ„בלתי נראים”, וצורות מגדריות, בנקודה או בלוכסן, נשארות כפי שנכתבו. שינויים מוצגים כהצעות – לעולם לא כעריכה שקטה.
בדיקת עבודה מוגמרת וארגון הממצאים – בלי לגעת בקבצים. כיוון, אותיות סופיות, מרווח לניקוד ואיזון בין כתבים נבדקים כנקודות נפרדות.

he.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜מקצב אינו מכתיב מראה מוגמר. הוא נותן ל-AI את הידע להתאים את העבודה לכל מדיום ולכל בריף. דגלים, סמלים דתיים או אותיות בסגנון תנ״כי לא יתווספו רק משום שהטקסט בעברית.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜מקצב — Natural Hebrew typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜מקצב is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Hebrew websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content. Coming soon.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜מקצב is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Hebrew websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content. It is built around what Hebrew actually needs: right-to-left text with English and numbers inside, final letters and niqqud, Hebrew punctuation, and gendered wording.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜מקצב helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Hebrew that starts with direction: right-aligned text is not automatically right-to-left.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Hebrew content.

features.h3: Right to left, with Latin inside
features.p: Set language and direction, lay out with logical start and end, and keep English names, versions, URLs and numbers as isolated spans—never reversed by hand. Tell geresh, gershayim and maqaf apart from quotes, apostrophes and hyphens.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Hebrew has no capitals, so hierarchy comes from weight, size, spacing and placement—and Hebrew and Latin are balanced by eye, not by matching font sizes.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, IDs and intended meaning. Final letters are never auto-swapped, niqqud is never stripped, bidi controls are not deleted as “invisible”, and gendered, dot or slash forms stay as written. Changes are proposals, never silent edits.
Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Direction, final letters, niqqud clearance and mixed-script balance are reviewed as separate points.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜מקצב doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Flags, religious symbols or biblical-style lettering are never added just because the text is Hebrew.

ja.nav_label: メインナビゲーション
ja.lead: AIとつくるヘブライ語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜מקצבは、ヘブライ語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。英字や数字が混じる右から左の文章、語末形とニクード、ヘブライ語固有の約物、性の書き分けまで、ヘブライ語ならではの課題を軸にしています。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜מקצבは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。ヘブライ語では、その出発点が方向です。右寄せにしただけでは、右から左の文章にはなりません。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜מקצבが大切にする考え方。

features.h3: 英字が混じる、右から左の文章
features.p: 言語と方向を指定し、論理的な始端・終端で配置します。英語の名前、版番号、URL、数字はひとまとまりとして分離し、文字を手作業で反転しません。ゲレシュ・ゲルシャイム・マカフを、引用符やアポストロフィ、ハイフンと区別します。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。大文字のないヘブライ語では、太さ・サイズ・余白・配置で階層をつくり、ヘブライ文字とラテン文字は同じ文字サイズではなく見た目で釣り合わせます。
名前・引用・数値・日時・ID・意味を守ります。語末形を自動で置き換えず、ニクードを削らず、方向制御文字を「見えないから」と消さず、性の書き分けやドット・スラッシュの表記も原稿のまま残します。変更は提案として示し、黙って書き換えません。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。方向、語末形、ニクードの余白、混植の釣り合いを別々の項目として確認します。

sa.title: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास — AI-साहाय्येन स्वाभाविकः संस्कृत-अक्षरविन्यासः
sa.description: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास संस्कृतजालपुटानां, लेखानां, प्रतिवेदनानां, प्रस्तुतीनां च निर्माणाय समीक्षणाय च मुक्तस्रोतसाम् AI-कौशलानां सङ्ग्रहः, यस्य विकासः सम्प्रति प्रचलति — पठनसौकर्यं, विन्यासः, मूलविषयस्य अखण्डता च इत्येतेषु अवधानेन।
sa.lead: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास संस्कृतजालपुटानां, लेखानां, प्रतिवेदनानां, प्रस्तुतीनां च निर्माणाय समीक्षणाय च मुक्तस्रोतसाम् AI-कौशलानां सङ्ग्रहः — पठनसौकर्यं, विन्यासः, मूलविषयस्य अखण्डता च इत्येतेषु अवधानेन। सम्पूर्णस्य अनुसन्धानस्य आधारेण अस्य विकासः प्रचलति — भाषा लिपिः च पृथक् गण्येते, पठनं सस्वरपाठः दर्शनं च भिन्नाः पठनप्रकाराः इति मन्यन्ते, संयुक्ताक्षराणि मात्राः IAST स्वरचिह्नानि च यथावत् रक्ष्यन्ते।
sa.concept_body: प्रत्येकं कार्यं, प्रत्येकः पाठकवर्गः, प्रत्येकः सन्देशः च भिन्नः। KUMIHAN｜विन्यास एकम् एव प्रारूपं सर्वत्र न प्रयोजयति, अपि तु प्रत्येकस्याः कृतेः अर्थं प्राथमिकतां च अनुसृत्य अक्षरविन्यासम्, अन्तरालं, पदानुक्रमं च रचयितुं AI-साधनानां साहाय्यं करोति। संस्कृते तस्य आरम्भः अयं प्रश्नः — पाठः निरन्तरं पठनीयः, सस्वरं पाठ्यः, उत शीर्षकम् इव चिह्नम् इव वा द्रष्टव्यः?
sa.features_deck: संस्कृतविषयस्य निर्माणाय समीक्षणाय च व्यावहारिक्यः प्राथमिकताः।

features.p: संस्कृतं केवलं देवनागर्यां न लिखितम्, देवनागरी दृश्यते इति मात्रेण पाठः हिन्दी अपि न भवति — अतः भाषा (sa) लिपिः (Deva, Latn/IAST) च पृथक् अभिलिख्येते। संयुक्ताक्षराणि कि इत्यादिषु पूर्वस्थिताः मात्राः च तार्किकक्रमे एव तिष्ठन्ति, दृश्यक्रमं तु रूपनिर्माणयन्त्रं (shaper) निर्धारयति। संयुक्ताक्षरमध्ये रिक्तस्थानं वर्णान्तरं वा न योज्यते, दीर्घसमासाः च बलात् न विभज्यन्ते।

सूचनां, तस्याः प्राथमिकतां, पाठकस्य लक्ष्यं च अनुसृत्य विन्यासं रचयतु। निरन्तरपठनं, सस्वरपाठः, शीर्षकचिह्नादीनां दर्शनं च भिन्नपठनप्रकाररूपेण अभिकल्प्यन्ते। मूलपाठः, लिप्यन्तरणम्, अनुवादः च समानपङ्क्तिसङ्ख्यायां बलात् न निवेश्यन्ते, अपि तु अर्थानुसारं संयोज्यन्ते।

नामानि, उद्धरणानि, सङ्ख्याः, तिथीः, कूटानि, अभिप्रेतार्थं च रक्षतु। संयुक्ताक्षराणि, मात्राः, IAST-चिह्नानि (ā ṛ ṣ ṃ ḥ), वैदिकस्वरचिह्नानि, दण्डः (। ॥), अवग्रहः (ऽ) च यथालिखितं तिष्ठन्ति, मूलपाठः संशोधितपाठः च पृथक् रक्ष्येते। सन्धिविच्छेदः, समासविभागः, पदक्रमपरिवर्तनं च सम्पादनकर्माणि — तानि प्रस्तावरूपेण अभिलिख्यन्ते, न तु तूष्णीं क्रियन्ते।

सञ्चिकाः अस्पृष्ट्वा सम्पूर्णं कार्यं परीक्ष्य समस्याः व्यवस्थापयतु। परिमाणम् अक्षरमानेन (point size) न, अपि तु मापितविस्तारेण निर्णीयते — अनुसन्धाने एकम् एव पदं समानमानेन चतसृषु अक्षरशैलीषु मुद्रितं प्रायः २१% भिन्नविस्तारम् अदृश्यत। रूपनिर्माणं, प्रतिलिपिः, PDF-पाठनिष्कर्षणं च पृथक् परीक्ष्यन्ते।

sa.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास सम्पूर्णम् अभिकल्पनम् एकरूपेण न निर्दिशति। प्रत्येकं माध्यमं कार्यं च अनुसृत्य विचारयितुं AI-साधनेभ्यः ज्ञानं ददाति। संस्कृतस्य कश्चन नियतः वर्णक्रमः नास्ति, न च तत् केवलं धार्मिकप्रयोगाय सीमितम्। अक्षरशैल्यः सञ्चिकासंस्करणेन, वर्णसङ्ग्रहेण, रूपनिर्माणेन, अनुज्ञया च तुल्यन्ते — यथा Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, Murty Sanskrit च सम्बद्धे अपि भिन्ननियमाधीने स्तः।

en.title: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास — Natural Sanskrit typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Sanskrit websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Sanskrit websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜विन्यास helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Sanskrit, that starts by asking whether a text is to be read continuously, chanted aloud, or seen as a heading or logo.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Sanskrit content.

features.p: Sanskrit has never been written only in Devanagari, and Devanagari on screen does not make a text Hindi, so language (sa) and script (Deva, Latn/IAST) are recorded separately. Conjuncts and pre-base vowel signs, as in कि, stay in logical order while the shaper handles the visual order; no spaces or tracking go inside clusters, and long compounds are not broken by force.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Continuous reading, chanting and display—headings, logos—are designed as different ways of reading, and source, transliteration and translation are aligned by meaning rather than forced into the same number of lines.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Conjuncts, vowel signs, IAST diacritics (ā ṛ ṣ ṃ ḥ), Vedic accent marks, danda (। ॥) and avagraha (ऽ) stay as written, and the source is kept apart from the edited text. Undoing sandhi, splitting compounds and reordering words are edits: recorded as proposals, never made silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Size is judged by measured width, not point size—in the research, one word set at the same size in four typefaces differed by about 21% in width—and rendering, copying and PDF text extraction are checked separately.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Sanskrit has no single colour scheme and is not limited to religious use. Typefaces are compared by file version, character coverage, shaping and licence—Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit and Murty Sanskrit, though related, come under different terms.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: विन्यास
Scope purpose, audience, medium, reading mode (prose, verse, commentary, chanting or display), script and transliteration (Devanagari, IAST) and authorized edits before designing.
Web
Typography and design for Sanskrit websites, articles, landing pages, and UI, with guidance on line height for marks above and below, long compounds and IAST beside Devanagari.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks, with guidance on aligning source, transliteration and translation, font licences and PDF text extraction.
Review
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.

ja.title: KUMIHAN｜विन्यास — サンスクリット語のデザインをもっと自然に
ja.description: KUMIHAN｜विन्यासは、AIによるサンスクリット語のWebサイト・文書・プレゼン資料の制作とレビューを支援する、オープンソースのスキル集です（現在開発中）。
ja.nav_label: メインナビゲーション
ja.lead: AIとつくるサンスクリット語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜विन्यास（Vinyāsa）は、サンスクリット語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。「文字を配し、読む流れを整える。」を掲げ、言語と文字体系の区別、読む・唱える・見せるの違い、結合文字・母音記号・IAST・声調の保全を軸に、完了した調査をもとに開発を進めています。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜विन्यासは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。サンスクリット語では、まずその文字が連続して読むものか、声に出して唱えるものか、見出しやロゴとして見せるものかを見極めます。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜विन्यासが大切にする考え方。

features.h3: サンスクリット語の文字組み
features.p: サンスクリット語はデーヴァナーガリーだけで書かれてきた言語ではなく、同じ字形が見えてもヒンディー語とは限りません。言語（sa）と文字体系（Deva、Latn／IAST）を別々に記録します。結合文字や कि のような前置母音記号は論理的な文字順のまま保ち、見た目の並びはシェーパーに任せます。結合の途中に空白や字間を入れず、長い複合語を無理に分割しません。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。連続して読む本文、唱える本文、見出しやロゴのように見せる文字を別の読み方として設計し、原文・転写・訳は行数をそろえるのではなく意味で対応させます。
名前・引用・数値・日時・コード・意味を守ります。結合文字、母音記号、IASTの符号（ā ṛ ṣ ṃ ḥ）、ヴェーダの声調記号、ダンダ（। ॥）、アヴァグラハ（ऽ）は書かれたとおりに保ち、原文と校訂を区別します。連声の解除、複合語の分割、語順の変更は編集にあたるため、提案として記録し、黙って書き換えません。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。大きさは字号ではなく実測の幅で判断し（調査では、同じ語を同じ字号で組んだ4書体の幅に約21％の差）、表示・コピー・PDFからの文字抽出を別々に確かめます。

idea_h2: 文字を並べるだけでなく
読む体験を組み立てる
ja.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜विन्यासは完成デザインを一律に指定しません。使う媒体や条件に合わせて考えるための知識を提供します。サンスクリット語に決まった配色はなく、宗教的な用途だけの言語でもありません。書体はファイルの版、収録文字、結合の処理、利用条件まで比べます。たとえばTiro Devanagari SanskritとMurty Sanskritは、来歴が関係していても利用条件が異なります。

サンスクリット語のWebサイト、記事、LP、UIの文字組みとデザインを支援。上下の記号に必要な行送り、長い複合語、デーヴァナーガリーとIASTの併用も扱います。

cs.title: KUMIHAN｜Soulad — Přirozená česká typografie s pomocí AI
cs.description: KUMIHAN｜Soulad je sada open-source dovedností pro AI, která pomáhá vytvářet a kontrolovat české weby, články, zprávy a prezentace – s ohledem na čitelnost, uspořádání a neporušenost původního obsahu.
cs.lead: KUMIHAN｜Soulad je sada open-source dovedností pro AI, která pomáhá vytvářet a kontrolovat české weby, články, zprávy a prezentace – s ohledem na čitelnost, uspořádání a neporušenost původního obsahu.
concept_h2: ale správná forma pro každé sdělení
cs.concept_body: Každé zadání, publikum i sdělení je jiné. KUMIHAN｜Soulad pomáhá AI utvářet typografii, mezery a hierarchii podle smyslu a priorit každého textu – místo aby na všechno použila jednu šablonu. V češtině to začíná otázkou, zda se text bude souvisle číst, procházet, rozpoznávat na první pohled, vnímat jako tvar, nebo zda podle něj má čtenář jednat.
cs.features_deck: Praktické priority pro tvorbu a kontrolu českého obsahu.

features.p: Čárka, háček a kroužek jsou součástí písmene, ne ozdobou: á a a, ů a ú, i a y jsou různé pravopisné tvary a verzálky Č, Ř a Ů si svá znaménka ponechávají. Ď a ť jsou samostatná písmena, jejichž háček může připomínat apostrof – nikdy je nenahrazujeme zápisem d’ nebo t’. Jednopísmenné předložky jako k, s, v a z nezůstávají na konci řádku a dělení slov se řídí stavbou českého slova, ne anglickými slovníky.

Rozvržení se řídí informacemi, jejich prioritou a cílem čtenáře. Souvislé čtení, vyhledávání, rychlé rozpoznání, písmo jako obraz a ovládací prvky navrhujeme jako odlišné role – podobně jako v Teigeho Abecedě (1926), kde báseň ke čtení a velká písmena k dívání sdílejí jednu knihu. Anglické Title Case do českých nadpisů nepřenášíme.

Chráníme jména, citace, čísla, data, kódy i zamýšlený význam. Mezera nese význam: 30 % je množství, 30% sleva přívlastek; 18 °C se píše s mezerou, 45° bez ní; 1 250,50 Kč a 20. 10. 2026 se řídí českými zvyklostmi a přípustné je 8.05 i 8:05. Uvozovky „…“ a ‚…‘ zůstávají, jak jsou. Slovosled, pádové koncovky i tykání a vykání nesou význam, takže jejich změna je úprava textu: zaznamená se jako návrh, nikdy se neprovede potichu.

Hotovou práci kontrolujeme a zjištění třídíme – bez zásahu do souborů. U písma nestačí, že znaky obsahuje: ověřuje se háček a čárka ve verzálkách, tučném řezu, kurzívě i v malých velikostech, těsné dvojice jako ďá a ťe a znaménka nad verzálkami, která mohou těsné nadpisy oříznout. Zvětšení, přeformátování a změněné mezery se ověřují ve skutečných prohlížečích a vše neověřené se tak také označí.

cs.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Soulad nepředepisuje hotový vzhled. Dává AI znalosti, jak se přizpůsobit každému médiu a zadání. Žádný jednotný „český styl“ neexistuje – červená s černou nebo zúžené verzálky jsou volbou, ne pravidlem – a český text nepotřebuje písmo vyrobené v Česku. Písma porovnáváme podle verze souboru, pokrytí znaků, tvaru ď a ť, číslic a licence.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Soulad — Natural Czech typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Soulad is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Czech websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Soulad is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Czech websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Soulad helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Czech, that starts by asking whether a text is to be read at length, scanned, recognized at a glance, looked at as form, or acted on.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Czech content.

features.p: Čárka, háček and kroužek are part of the letter, not decoration: á and a, ů and ú, i and y are different spellings, and the capitals Č, Ř and Ů keep their marks. Ď and ť are single letters whose háček can look like an apostrophe—never d’ or t’. One-letter prepositions such as k, s, v and z are not left at the end of a line, and hyphenation follows Czech word structure, not English dictionaries.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Continuous reading, scanning, quick recognition, letters as image and interface labels are designed as different roles—as in Teige’s Abeceda (1926), where a poem to be read and large letters to be looked at share one book. English Title Case is not carried over to Czech headings.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Spaces carry meaning: 30 % is a quantity, 30% sleva an adjective; 18 °C takes a space, 45° does not; 1 250,50 Kč and 20. 10. 2026 follow Czech conventions, and both 8.05 and 8:05 are accepted. Quotation marks „…“ and ‚…‘ stay as written. Word order, case endings and ty/vy carry meaning, so changing them is an edit: recorded as a proposal, never made silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. A typeface is checked for more than having the glyphs: háček and čárka in capitals, bold, italic and small sizes, close pairs such as ďá and ťe, and marks above capitals that tight headings can clip. Zoom, reflow and changed text spacing are checked in real browsers, and anything unverified is reported as unverified.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Soulad doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. There is no single “Czech style”—red and black or condensed capitals are choices, not rules—and Czech text does not need a Czech-made typeface. Typefaces are compared by file version, character coverage, the shape of ď and ť, figures and licence.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: Soulad
Scope purpose, audience, medium, the role of each text (continuous reading, scanning, display, form or interface), register (ty or vy, standard or colloquial) and authorized edits before designing.
Web

Typography and design for Czech websites, articles, landing pages, and UI, with guidance on one-letter prepositions at line ends, Czech hyphenation, spaces in numbers and units, and line height for accented capitals.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks, with guidance on Czech quotation marks and dashes, dates and numbers, font coverage and licences.
Review
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.

ja.title: KUMIHAN｜Soulad — チェコ語のデザインをもっと自然に
ja.description: KUMIHAN｜Souladは、AIによるチェコ語のWebサイト・文書・プレゼン資料の制作とレビューを支援する、オープンソースのスキル集です（現在開発中）。
ja.nav_label: メインナビゲーション
ja.lead: AIとつくるチェコ語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜Soulad（ソウラト）は、チェコ語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。「Písmo. Prostor. Soulad.（文字。空間。調和。）」を掲げ、háček・čárka・kroužekを含む文字の同一性、一文字の前置詞の改行、意味で変わる数値の空白、読む・探す・見せるの役割の違いを軸に、完了した調査をもとに開発を進めています。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜Souladは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。チェコ語では、まずその文字が続けて読むものか、探すものか、ひと目で見分けるものか、形として見せるものか、操作のためのものかを見極めます。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜Souladが大切にする考え方。

features.p: čárka・háček・kroužekは飾りではなく文字の一部です。áとa、ůとú、iとyは別の綴りで、大文字のČ・Ř・Ůでも記号を落としません。ď・ťのháčekはアポストロフィに似て見えても文字の一部で、d’やt’に置き換えません。k・s・v・zなど一文字の前置詞を行末に残さず、分綴は英語の辞書ではなくチェコ語の語の構造に従います。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。続けて読む本文、探す一覧、ひと目で見分ける名前、形として見せる文字、操作のラベルを別の役割として設計します。Teigeの『Abeceda』（1926年）では、読む詩と見る大きな文字が一冊の中で役割を分けています。英語のTitle Caseはチェコ語の見出しに持ち込みません。

名前・引用・数値・日時・コード・意味を守ります。空白は意味を区別します。30 %は数量、30% slevaは「30％引き」という形容詞的な用法です。18 °Cは空け、45°は空けません。1 250,50 Kčや20. 10. 2026はチェコ語の慣行に従い、時刻は8.05も8:05も認めます。引用符„…“‚…‘は書かれたとおりに保ちます。語順、格語尾、ty／vy（親称・敬称）は意味を担うため、変更は編集として提案に記録し、黙って書き換えません。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。書体は文字が収録されているかだけでなく、大文字・太字・斜体・小さいサイズでのháčekとčárka、ďáやťeのような接近する組合せ、詰めた見出しで欠けやすい大文字上の記号まで確かめます。拡大、リフロー、間隔の変更は実際のブラウザで確認し、未確認のものは未確認として報告します。

idea_h2: 文字を並べるだけでなく
読む体験を組み立てる
ja.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Souladは完成デザインを一律に指定しません。使う媒体や条件に合わせて考えるための知識を提供します。「チェコらしい」単一の様式はなく、赤と黒や凝縮した大文字も選択肢の一つにすぎません。チェコ語だからチェコ製の書体に限る必要もありません。書体はファイルの版、収録文字、ď・ťの形、数字、利用条件まで比べます。
ja.skills_deck: 制作の入口から、Web・資料制作・レビューまで。
skills: Soulad
目的・読者・媒体・文字の役割（続けて読む、探す、見出し、形、操作）・文体（ty／vy、標準語・口語）・編集権限を先に整理します。
Web
チェコ語のWebサイト、記事、LP、UIの文字組みとデザインを支援。一文字の前置詞の改行、チェコ語の分綴、数値と単位の空白、記号付き大文字の行送りも扱います。
Documents
報告書、資料、プレゼンテーションの構成と読みやすさを支援。チェコ語の引用符とダッシュ、日付と数値、書体の収録文字と利用条件も扱います。
Review
制作物を変更せず、組版・情報・デザインの見直しを支援。

hu.title: KUMIHAN｜Arány — Természetes magyar tipográfia, MI-támogatással
hu.description: A KUMIHAN｜Arány nyílt forráskódú MI-készségek gyűjteménye magyar nyelvű weboldalak, cikkek, jelentések és prezentációk készítéséhez és átnézéséhez – fejlesztés alatt. Figyel az olvashatóságra, az elrendezésre és az eredeti tartalom épségére.
hu.lead: A KUMIHAN｜Arány nyílt forráskódú MI-készségek gyűjteménye magyar nyelvű weboldalak, cikkek, jelentések és prezentációk készítéséhez és átnézéséhez – az olvashatóságra, az elrendezésre és az eredeti tartalom épségére figyelve. Fejlesztése lezárt kutatásra épül: az ő és az ű sosem válik ö-vé és ü-vé, a cs, az sz és a dzs egy-egy betű, a sorvégi elválasztás nem írja át a helyesírást, az arányt pedig a szövegrész szerepe határozza meg.
concept_h2: hanem minden üzenetnek a maga formája
hu.concept_body: Minden megbízás, közönség és üzenet más. A KUMIHAN｜Arány abban segíti az MI-t, hogy a tipográfiát, a térközöket és a hierarchiát az egyes anyagok jelentéséhez és prioritásaihoz igazítsa, ahelyett hogy mindenre ugyanazt a sablont húzná rá. Magyar szövegnél ez azzal kezdődik, hogy eldöntjük: az adott rész olvasásra, megnézésre, azonosításra vagy használatra való – az arány ebből a szerepből következik.
hu.features_deck: Gyakorlati szempontok magyar nyelvű tartalmak készítéséhez és átnézéséhez.

features.p: A kettős ékezetes hosszú ő és ű önálló betű, nem az ö és az ü változata, ezért nem pótolható hasonló alakú jelekkel, és az Ő és az Ű a csupa nagybetűs címekben, gombokon és maszkokban is megtartja az ékezetét. A cs, az sz, a gy, az ny és a dzs egy-egy betűje az ábécének: a CS és a Cs egyaránt helyes nagybetűs alak, a betűrendben a csak a cukor után jön, és az a grafémabontás, amely a dzs-t három részre szedi, nem a magyar betűket számolja.

Az elrendezés az információhoz, annak fontosságához és az olvasó céljához igazodik. Az olvasásra, megnézésre, azonosításra és használatra szánt szöveg más-más arányt kap – a kutatásban egy színház cikkcíme a kenyérszöveg négyszerese, egy stúdió címsora a leírás 1,4-szerese volt. A hosszú összetett szavak nem kicsinyítéssel vagy csonkítással kerülnek a helyükre, a sorvégi elválasztás pedig külön kezelendő a helyesírástól: az Összeg elválasztva Ösz-szeg.

Védi a neveket, az idézeteket, a számokat, a dátumokat, a kódokat és a szándékolt jelentést. Az idézőjel kívül „…”, belül »…«; a 10 000 megtartja a nem törhető szóközt, a 12 345,67 a tizedesvesszőt, a 2026. október 20. a pontjait. A magyar nevekben a családnév áll elöl, a külföldi nevek sorrendjét azonban nem fordítjuk meg. A szórend módosítása – amely a mondat fókuszát is áthelyezheti – vagy a tegezés és a magázás közti váltás szerkesztésnek számít: javaslatként rögzítjük, sosem csendben.

A kész munka ellenőrzése és a problémák rendszerezése – a fájlok érintése nélkül. Megnézzük, nem vágódik-e le az Ő és az Ű ékezete csupa nagybetűs, dőlt vagy vastag szedésben, és hogy az elválasztott szó másoláskor és keresésben az eredeti alakjában tér-e vissza. A betűtípus-támogatást fájlonként ítéljük meg: a kutatásban négy betűtípusfájlban egyezett az NFC és az NFD alak feldolgozása, ez azonban nem garancia minden eszközre és betűvastagságra.

hu.idea_body: A KUMIHAN｜Arány nem ír elő kész megjelenést. Olyan tudást ad az MI-nek, amellyel minden médiumhoz és megbízáshoz alkalmazkodni tud. A magyar tervezésnek nincs egyetlen stílusa: Kis Miklós betűinek hagyománya és Kassák Lajos konstruktív címlapjai más-más célt szolgáltak. A betűtípusokat fájl, verzió, az Ő ő Ű ű megléte, a változó tengelyek és a licenc alapján vetjük össze – a tervező nemzetisége semmit sem mond a magyar támogatásról.
hu.skills_deck: A feladat körülhatárolásától a weben és a dokumentumokon át az átnézésig.
skills: Arány

Tervezés előtt tisztázza a célt, a közönséget, a médiumot, az egyes szövegrészek szerepét (olvasás, megnézés, azonosítás, használat), a beszélőt és a megszólítást (tegezés vagy magázás), valamint az engedélyezett szerkesztéseket.
Web

Tipográfia és tervezés magyar weboldalakhoz, cikkekhez, landing oldalakhoz és felhasználói felületekhez – útmutatással a levágott Ő és Ű, a hosszú összetett szavak és az elválasztás, valamint a szám- és dátumformátumok kérdéséhez.
Documents

Szerkezet és olvashatóság jelentésekhez, üzleti dokumentumokhoz és diasorokhoz – útmutatással a „…” és »…« idézőjelekhez, a számtáblázatokhoz, a betűtípus-licencekhez és a PDF-ből való szövegkinyeréshez.

A tipográfia, az információ és az elrendezés átnézése a forrásfájlok módosítása nélkül.

en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Hungarian content.

features.p: The long vowels ő and ű, with their double acute, are letters of their own—not ö and ü—so they are never swapped for look-alikes, and Ő and Ű keep their marks in all-caps headings, buttons and masks. Cs, sz, gy, ny and dzs are each one letter of the alphabet: CS and Cs are both correct capitals, csak sorts after cukor, and a grapheme segmenter that splits dzs into three is not counting Hungarian letters.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Text to be read, looked at, recognized or acted on gets its own proportions—in the research, one theatre’s article heading was four times its body text, one studio’s heading 1.4 times its description. Long compounds are not shrunk or cut to fit, and line-end hyphenation is kept apart from spelling: Összeg breaks as Ösz-szeg.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Quotation marks nest as „…” outside and »…« inside; 10 000 keeps its no-break space, 12 345,67 its decimal comma and 2026. október 20. its full stops. Hungarian names put the family name first, but foreign names are not reversed. Changing word order, which can shift a sentence’s focus, or switching between familiar and formal address is an edit: recorded as a proposal, never made silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Ő and Ű are checked for clipped marks in capitals, italics and heavy weights, hyphenated words must still copy and search as written, and font support is judged file by file—in the research, NFC and NFD forms shaped identically in the four font files tested, which is no guarantee for every device or weight.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Arány doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Hungarian design has no single style: the type lineage of Miklós Kis and Lajos Kassák’s constructive covers served different ends. Typefaces are compared by file, version, coverage of Ő ő Ű ű, axes and licence—a designer’s nationality says nothing about Hungarian support.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.

Scope purpose, audience, medium, the role of each block (read, look, recognize, act), speaker and form of address (familiar or formal) and authorized edits before designing.

Typography and design for Hungarian websites, articles, landing pages, and UI, with guidance on clipped Ő and Ű, long compounds and hyphenation, and number and date formats.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks, with guidance on „…” and »…« quotes, tables of figures, font licences and PDF text extraction.

Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.

ja.description: KUMIHAN｜Arányは、AIによるハンガリー語のWebサイト・文書・プレゼン資料の制作とレビューを支援する、オープンソースのスキル集です（現在開発中）。

ja.lead: AIとつくるハンガリー語のWebサイト、記事、報告書、プレゼンテーション。読みやすさも、伝わりやすさも、内容を大切にすることも。KUMIHAN｜Arány（アラーニ）は、ハンガリー語のための制作・レビュースキル集です。「文字・行・余白の比率を整える。」を掲げ、ő・űとö・üの区別、cs・sz・dzsなどの字母、綴りと行末の分綴の区別、役割に応じた比率を軸に、完了した調査をもとに開発を進めています。
ja.concept_body: 目的も読み手も違うのに、同じ構成を繰り返さない。文章の意味や情報の優先順位を踏まえて、文字組み・余白・レイアウトを考える。KUMIHAN｜Arányは、デザインを画一化するためではなく、一つひとつの制作物をよりよくするための指針を提供します。ハンガリー語では、まずその部分が読むものか、見せるものか、識別するものか、操作するものかを見極め、そこから比率（arány）を決めます。
ja.features_h2: 伝えるための4つの視点
ja.features_deck: 制作と見直しに共通する、KUMIHAN｜Arányが大切にする考え方。

features.h3: ハンガリー語の文字組み
features.p: 二重アキュートの長母音ő・űは、ö・üとは別の文字です。形の似た文字で代用せず、全大文字の見出しやボタン、マスクでもŐ・Űの記号を落としません。cs・sz・gy・ny・dzsはそれぞれ一つの字母で、CSもCsも正しい大文字化です。辞書順ではcsakがcukorの後に来ます。dzsを3つに分ける一般的な書記素分割は、ハンガリー語の字母の数え方とは一致しません。
伝える順番と情報の重要度を整理し、目的に合ったレイアウトを考えます。読む文字、見せる文字、識別する文字、操作する文字で比率を変えます（調査では、ある劇場の記事見出しは本文の4倍、ある制作会社の見出しは説明文の1.4倍）。長い複合語は縮小や切断で収めず、行末の分綴を綴りと区別します。Összegは行末で分綴するとÖsz-szegになります。
名前・引用・数値・日時・コード・意味を守ります。引用符は外側が„…”、内側が»…«。10 000の改行しない空白、12 345,67の小数点のコンマ、2026. október 20.の句点を保ちます。ハンガリー人の名前は姓が先ですが、外国人名の順序は入れ替えません。文の焦点が変わりうる語順の変更や、親称と丁寧形の切り替えは編集にあたるため、提案として記録し、黙って書き換えません。
完成物の気になる点を、対象を変更せずに確認・整理するための指針です。全大文字・イタリック・太いウェイトでŐ・Űの記号が欠けていないか、分綴した語をコピー・検索したときに原文どおりに戻るかを確かめます。書体の対応はファイル単位で判断します（調査では4つのフォントファイルでNFCとNFDの処理結果が一致しましたが、全端末・全ウェイトの保証ではありません）。

idea_h2: 文字を並べるだけでなく
読む体験を組み立てる
ja.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Arányは完成デザインを一律に指定しません。使う媒体や条件に合わせて考えるための知識を提供します。ハンガリーのデザインは一つの様式にまとめられません。キシュ・ミクローシュの活字の系譜と、カシャーク・ラヨシュの構成的な表紙は、目的の異なる流れです。書体はファイル、版、Ő ő Ű űの収録、可変軸、利用条件まで比べます。設計者の国籍は、ハンガリー語への対応を示すものではありません。

ハンガリー語のWebサイト、記事、LP、UIの文字組みとデザインを支援。Ő・Űの欠け、長い複合語と分綴、数値・日付の書式も扱います。

features.h3: မြန်မာစာစီစာရိုက်
features.p: မြန်မာအက္ခရာကို မွန်၊ ရှမ်း၊ ကရင် ဘာသာစကားများနှင့် ပါဠိတွင်လည်း အသုံးပြုသဖြင့် ဘာသာစကား (my) နှင့် အက္ခရာစနစ် (Mymr) ကို ခွဲခြား မှတ်တမ်းတင်သည်။ ယူနီကုဒ်နှင့် ဇော်ဂျီကိုလည်း မရောထွေးစေရ—ဖောင့်ပြောင်းရုံဖြင့် မဖြေရှင်းနိုင်ပါ။ ကင်းစီး၊ ပဆင့်၊ ဗျည်းတွဲနှင့် သရများကို ယုတ္တိအစီအစဉ်အတိုင်း သိမ်းဆည်းပြီး မြင်ရမည့်နေရာကို shaper က နေရာချသည်။ ပေါင်းစပ်စာလုံးအစု အတွင်းသို့ span၊ အရောင်ခွဲခြင်း သို့မဟုတ် စာလုံးကြားအကွာ မထည့်ပါ။

features.p: သတင်းအချက်အလက်၊ ၎င်း၏ ဦးစားပေးအဆင့်နှင့် ဖတ်ရှုသူ၏ ရည်မှန်းချက်ပေါ် မူတည်၍ အပြင်အဆင်ကို ပုံဖော်ပါ။ စာကိုယ်၊ UI စာတန်း၊ ခေါင်းစီးနှင့် စာလုံးဒီဇိုင်းတို့ကို မတူညီသော အခန်းကဏ္ဍများအဖြစ် ဒီဇိုင်းဆွဲသည်။ မြန်မာစာ၏ ကွက်လပ်သည် စကားလုံးတိုင်းကို မခြားဘဲ စကားစုကို ပြသဖြင့် break-all ကို အလုံးစုံ မသုံးဘဲ၊ ဝဏ္ဏတိုင်းနောက်တွင် zero-width space မထည့်ဘဲ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရှိသော စကားစုတွင် စာကြောင်းခွဲသည်။ ခေါင်းစီးနှင့် စာကိုယ် အချိုးကိုလည်း မျက်နှာပြင် အကျယ်အလိုက် ပြောင်းလဲသည်။

features.h3: မူရင်းကို ထိန်းသိမ်းခြင်း
features.p: အမည်၊ ကိုးကားချက်၊ ကိန်းဂဏန်း၊ ရက်စွဲ၊ ကုဒ်နှင့် ရည်ရွယ်သည့် အဓိပ္ပာယ်ကို ကာကွယ်ပါ။ ယူနီကုဒ် မူရင်းစာ၊ ပုဒ်ဖြတ် (၊) နှင့် ပုဒ်မ (။)၊ မြန်မာဂဏန်းများ၊ ဗျည်း ဝ နှင့် ဂဏန်း ၀ (သုည) ကဲ့သို့ ပုံသဏ္ဌာန်တူ စာလုံးများကို ရေးထားသည့်အတိုင်း ထိန်းသိမ်းသည်။ ဇော်ဂျီမှ ပြောင်းလဲခြင်း၊ ပြောစကားနှင့် စာစကားအကြား ပြောင်းခြင်း၊ စာသားကို အတိုချုံ့ခြင်းတို့သည် တည်းဖြတ်မှုများ ဖြစ်၍ အထောက်အထားနှင့်အတူ အကြံပြုချက်အဖြစ်သာ တင်ပြပြီး တိတ်တဆိတ် မပြင်ပါ။

features.h3: ဖတ်ရှုရုံသာ ပြန်လည်သုံးသပ်ခြင်း
features.p: ပြီးစီးသော လက်ရာကို ဖိုင်များ မထိဘဲ စစ်ဆေးပြီး ပြဿနာများကို စနစ်တကျ စီစဉ်ပါ။ အရွယ်အစားကို point size ဖြင့်မဟုတ်ဘဲ တိုင်းတာထားသော အတိုင်းအတာဖြင့် ဆုံးဖြတ်သည်—သုတေသနတွင် အရွယ်အစားတူ ဖောင့်လေးမျိုးဖြင့် စီထားသော အခြေခံဗျည်း က ၏ အမြင့်သည် ၀.၄၆၃–၀.၆၄၀ em အထိ ကွာခြားသည်။ အပေါ်နှင့်အောက် သင်္ကေတများ ဖြတ်တောက်ခံရခြင်း၊ ကူးယူခြင်းနှင့် PDF မှ စာသားထုတ်ယူခြင်းကို သီးခြားစီ စစ်ဆေးသည်။

my.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက်သည် ပြီးပြည့်စုံသော ဒီဇိုင်းပုံစံကို တစ်မျိုးတည်း မသတ်မှတ်ပါ။ မီဒီယာနှင့် လုပ်ငန်းတာဝန် တစ်ခုချင်းစီနှင့် လိုက်လျောညီထွေ ဖြစ်စေရန် AI အား အသိပညာ ပေးသည်။ မြန်မာဒီဇိုင်းသည် စက်ဝိုင်း၊ စေတီ၊ ရွှေရောင် စသည့် ပုံသေအစုတစ်ခု မဟုတ်သလို မြန်မာစာလုံးပုံစံများလည်း အားလုံး ဝိုင်းနေသည် မဟုတ်ပါ။ ဖောင့်များကို ဖိုင်ဗားရှင်း၊ ပါဝင်သော စာလုံးများ၊ shaping နှင့် လိုင်စင်အလိုက် နှိုင်းယှဉ်သည်—ဥပမာ Padauk 6.000 တွင် Graphite ကို ဖယ်ရှားလိုက်သဖြင့် ယခင် တပ်ဆင်နည်း လမ်းညွှန်များ မသက်ဆိုင်တော့ပါ။

en.title: KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက် — Natural Burmese typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက် is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Burmese websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက် is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Burmese websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက် helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Burmese, that starts by asking whether a text is to be read as continuous prose, used in an interface, or shown as a headline or lettering—and whether a spoken or literary style suits its purpose.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Burmese content.

features.p: Myanmar script is also used for Mon, Shan, the Karen languages and Pali, so language (my) and script (Mymr) are recorded separately, and Unicode is never confused with Zawgyi—swapping the font does not fix it. Kinzi, stacked consonants, medials and vowel signs stay in logical order while the shaper places them; no spans, colour changes or tracking go inside a cluster.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Body text, interface labels, headlines and lettering are designed as different roles. Spaces in Burmese mark phrases, not every word, so lines break at meaningful phrases—not with a blanket break-all or a zero-width space after every syllable—and the heading-to-body ratio changes with screen width.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. The original Unicode text, the punctuation marks ၊ and ။, Myanmar digits and look-alikes such as the letter ဝ (wa) and the digit ၀ (zero) stay as written. Converting from Zawgyi, switching between spoken and literary style and shortening copy are edits: offered as proposals with their basis, never made silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Size is judged by measured extent, not point size—in the research, the base letter က set at the same size in four typefaces measured 0.463–0.640 em high—and clipped marks above and below, copying and PDF text extraction are checked separately.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜ဟန်ချက် doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Burmese design is not a fixed set of circles, temples and gold, and Burmese letterforms are not all round. Typefaces are compared by file version, character coverage, shaping and licence—Padauk 6.000, for example, dropped Graphite, so older setup advice no longer applies.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: ဟန်ချက်
Scope purpose, audience, medium, text role (body, UI, headline or lettering), spoken or literary style, encoding (Unicode or Zawgyi) and authorized edits before designing.
Web
Typography and design for Burmese websites, articles, landing pages, and UI, with guidance on line height for marks above and below, line breaks by phrase and correct language tagging.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks, with guidance on font versions, mixing Burmese, English and numerals, and PDF copying and text extraction.
Review
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.

en.status_body: v0.1.0 (planned) is in development, based on completed research. Four skills are planned—kumihan-hanhkyak, -web, -documents and -review (names tentative)—but no rule set has been fixed yet. The research proposes modern Burmese (my) in Unicode as the initial focus, starting with protecting the source text and cluster structure; other languages written in Myanmar script, such as Mon, Shan, Karen and Pali, would need separate profiles, and automatic style rewriting and lettering need further evidence. Distribution, browser rendering and the choice of typeface are not yet verified, and the Burmese copy on this site has not yet been reviewed by a native speaker.

la.title: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas — Typographia Latina naturalis, ope intellegentiae artificialis
la.description: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas est collectio facultatum fontis aperti, quae nunc paratur, quibus intellegentia artificialis adiuvatur, cum situs interretiales, commentarios, relationes et praesentationes Latinas conficit et recenset — ratione habita legibilitatis, dispositionis et integritatis textus primigenii.
la.lead: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas est collectio facultatum fontis aperti quibus intellegentia artificialis adiuvatur, cum situs interretiales, commentarios, relationes et praesentationes Latinas conficit et recenset — ratione habita legibilitatis, dispositionis et integritatis textus primigenii. Ex investigatione iam perfecta paratur: linguam Latinam a scriptura Latina distinguit, legendi, discendi, recitandi et ostendendi modos separat, litteras I/J et U/V, æ/œ, signa longitudinis et compendia ita servat, ut editio ea praebet.
la.concept_body: Omne opus, omnes lectores, omnis nuntius differunt. KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas intellegentiam artificialem adiuvat, ut litteras, spatia et ordinem partium ad sensum et momentum cuiusque operis accommodet, non ut unam formulam omnibus imponat. In lingua Latina primum quaeritur, utrum textus continenter legendus, cum notis discendus, voce recitandus, an tamquam titulus vel sententia brevis spectandus sit.
la.features_deck: Praecepta usui apta ad res Latinas conficiendas et recensendas.

features.p: Lingua Latina (la) non idem est ac scriptura Latina (Latn): non omnis textus litteris Latinis scriptus Latinus est, itaque lingua et scriptura separatim notantur. Signa longitudinis, brevitatis et accentus (ā, ĭ, á) litteris suis adhaerent nec umquam ab iis divelluntur; spatia inter litteras non inseruntur, et typi litterarum fasciculo singulo probantur, num ā, ȳ, æ, œ, ǣ contineant.

Dispositionem ad res, earum momentum et lectoris propositum accommoda. Lectio continua, studium cum notis, recitatio et tituli brevesque sententiae ut diversi legendi modi designantur. Notae, versiones et soni cum textu per locum et indicem coniunguntur, non solum minoribus litteris, et versus poematum a lineis distinguuntur, quas latitudo paginae frangit.

Nomina, citationes, numeros, dies, signa et sensum propositum serva. I/J et U/V, ae/æ et oe/œ, signa longitudinis et accentus, compendia, ordo verborum et particulae ut -que manent, ut editio ea praebet; nihil ex solo aevi nomine mutatur (“mediaevale, ergo e”), nec textus primigenius tacite ad normam Unicode redigitur (ſ, ﬁ). Compendia resolvere, lacunas supplere, convertere emendationes sunt: ut propositiones notantur, numquam tacite fiunt.

Opus perfectum inspice et vitia ordina — fasciculis intactis. Magnitudo non ex punctis typographicis, sed ex altitudine litterarum minuscularum et latitudine mensa iudicatur — in investigatione eadem sententia duodenis punctis duobus typis composita latitudine circiter 15% differebat — et paginae angustae, amplificatio, divisio syllabarum et textus ex PDF extractus separatim probantur.

la.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas speciem perfectam non praescribit; intellegentiae artificiali scientiam praebet, qua se ad quodque medium et propositum accommodet. Lingua Latina non unam habet speciem nec ad inscriptiones Romanas aut Ecclesiam restringitur: hodie quoque in nuntiis, ephemeridibus et instrumentis discendi legitur. Typi litterarum ex fasciculo, editione, copia signorum et licentia comparantur — EB Garamond ex specimine typorum anni 1592 renovatus est, Trajan autem typus hodiernus ad titulos ex inscriptionibus Romanis ductus.
la.skills_deck: A fine operis definiendo ad situs interretiales, documenta et recensionem.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas — Natural Latin typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Latin websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Latin websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Latin, that starts by asking whether a text is to be read continuously, studied with notes, read aloud, or seen as a title or motto.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Latin content.

features.p: The Latin language (la) is not the Latin script (Latn): not every text in Latin letters is Latin, so language and script are recorded separately. Macrons, breves and accents (ā, ĭ, á) stay attached to their letters and are never split; no spaces are inserted between letters for tracking, and typefaces are checked file by file for ā, ȳ, æ, œ and ǣ.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Continuous reading, study with notes, recitation and short titles or mottos are designed as different ways of reading. Notes, translations and audio are linked to the text by position and reference—not just set smaller—and lines of verse are kept apart from screen wrapping.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. I/J and U/V, ae/æ and oe/œ, macrons and accents, abbreviations, word order and enclitics such as -que stay as the edition has them; nothing is changed from a period label alone (“medieval, so e”), and the source is never silently Unicode-normalized (ſ, ﬁ). Expanding abbreviations, restoring text and translating are edits: recorded as proposals, never made silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Size is judged by x-height and measured width, not point size—in the research, the same sentence set at 12 pt in two typefaces differed in width by about 15%—and narrow screens, zoom, hyphenation and PDF text extraction are checked separately.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Concinnitas doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. Latin has no single look and is not limited to Roman inscriptions or the Church: it is read today in news, magazines and learning apps. Typefaces are compared by file, version, character coverage and licence—EB Garamond revives a 1592 type specimen, while Trajan is a modern display face drawn from Roman inscriptions.
en.skills_deck: From scoping the work to web, documents, and review.
skills: Concinnitas
Scope purpose, audience, medium, reading mode (prose, verse, commentary, recitation or display), period and editorial policy (I/J, U/V, æ, macrons) and authorized edits before designing.
Web
Typography and design for Latin websites, articles, landing pages, and UI, with guidance on line height for macrons and accents, long words and hyphenation, and narrow screens.
Documents
Structure and readability for reports, business documents, and slide decks, with guidance on aligning text, notes and translation, font licences and PDF text extraction.
Review
Review typography, information, and layout without editing source files.

features.p: Ang Tagalog ang ubod ng Filipino, pero hindi magkapalit ang dalawang pangalan, kaya iniingatan ang tl at fil ayon sa pagkakabigay. Inuuna ang modernong alpabetong Latin; hiwalay na profile ang Baybayin na pinipili para sa malinaw na layunin, at hindi ito awtomatikong ginagamit dahil lang sa pangalan ng wika. Kabilang ang Ñ at Ng sa 28 titik ng alpabeto, pero dalawang karakter ang Ng, at nananatili ang tuldik gaya ng sa tugmâ.

Hubugin ang layout ayon sa impormasyon, sa prayoridad nito, at sa layunin ng mambabasa. Hindi ipinipilit ang pangungusap na Tagalog sa hugis ng pamagat na Ingles: sumusunod sa parirala ang hati ng linya, hindi tinatanggal ang maiikling salitang gaya ng na, pa, ba, at po para lang makatipid ng espasyo, at sa espasyo bumabalot ang karaniwang salita, hindi sa gitna nito.

Pangalagaan ang mga pangalan, sipi, numero, petsa, code, at nilalayong kahulugan. Nananatili gaya ng pagkakasulat ang tuldik, ñ, gitling sa loob ng salita gaya ng sa pag-ibig, at kudlit (’), at itinuturing na rehistro ang Taglish gaya ng i-save, hindi pagkakamali sa salin. Pasya ng editor ang ng/nang, din/rin, at po: itinatala bilang mungkahi, hindi binabago nang palihim.

Suriin ang tapos na gawa at ayusin ang mga isyu—nang hindi ginagalaw ang mga file. Hinuhusgahan ang font ayon sa bersiyon ng file at sa aktuwal na mga glyph, hindi sa pangalan—sa pananaliksik, may Baybayin ang Noto Sans Tagalog 2.002 pero walang ₱, samantalang may ₱ ang Source Sans 3 pero walang Baybayin—at hiwalay na sinusuri ang rendering, makikitid na screen, at zoom.

idea_h2: Higit pa sa pag-aayos ng titik
tl.idea_body: Hindi nagdidikta ang KUMIHAN｜Tugma ng tapos na itsura. Binibigyan nito ang AI ng kaalaman para umangkop sa bawat midyum at brief. Walang iisang “itsurang Pilipino”: hinango ng mga pinag-aralang typeface ang kanilang hugis sa mga karatulang pininta-kamay sa sasakyan at palengke o sa himig ng kundiman, at may dahilan ang bawat isa. Inihahambing ang mga typeface ayon sa bersiyon, saklaw ng karakter, at lisensiya—halimbawa, libre lamang ang Kundiman para sa personal na gamit.
tl.skills_deck: Mula sa pagtatakda ng saklaw ng gawain hanggang sa web, dokumento, at pagsusuri.

Web

Tipograpiya at disenyo para sa mga website, artikulo, landing page, at UI sa Tagalog, kasama ang gabay sa Taglish, mahahabang salitang may panlapi, at ratio ng heading at body text na nagbabago ayon sa lapad ng screen.
Documents

Estruktura at linaw ng pagbasa para sa mga ulat, dokumentong pangnegosyo, at slide deck, kasama ang gabay sa lisensiya ng font, saklaw ng ₱ at mga titik na may tuldik, at pagkuha ng teksto mula sa PDF.
Review
Pagsusuri ng tipograpiya, impormasyon, at layout nang hindi binabago ang mga source file.

en.description: KUMIHAN｜Tugma is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Tagalog websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Tugma is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing Tagalog websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Tugma helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In Tagalog, that starts by asking whether a text is to be read through, seen as a lead line or logo, or used—as a button, a price or a date.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing Tagalog content.

features.p: Tagalog is the core of Filipino, but the two names are not interchangeable, so tl and fil are kept as given. Modern Latin script comes first; Baybayin is a separate profile chosen for a stated purpose, never picked automatically from the language name. Ñ and Ng belong to the 28-letter alphabet, yet Ng is two characters, and accents as in tugmâ stay exactly as written.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. A Tagalog sentence is not forced into the shape of an English headline: lines break by Tagalog phrase, short words such as na, pa, ba and po are never dropped to save space, and ordinary words wrap at spaces, not in the middle.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Accents, ñ, in-word hyphens as in pag-ibig and the apostrophe ’ stay as written, and Taglish such as i-save is kept as a register, not treated as a failed translation. Ng/nang, din/rin and po are editorial calls: recorded as proposals, never changed silently.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Fonts are judged by file version and actual glyphs, not by name—in the research, Noto Sans Tagalog 2.002 covered Baybayin but had no ₱, while Source Sans 3 had ₱ but no Baybayin—and rendering, narrow screens and zoom are checked separately.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Tugma doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. There is no single “Filipino look”: the typefaces studied take their shapes from hand-lettered transport and market signs or the melody of the kundiman, each for a reason. Typefaces are compared by version, character coverage and licence—Kundiman, for example, is free for personal use only.

en.title: KUMIHAN｜Measure — Natural English typography, made with AI
en.description: KUMIHAN｜Measure is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing English websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
en.lead: KUMIHAN｜Measure is a set of open-source AI skills for creating and reviewing English websites, articles, reports, and presentations—with care for readability, layout, and the integrity of your original content.
concept_h2: the right form for each message
en.concept_body: Every brief, audience, and message is different. KUMIHAN｜Measure helps AI shape typography, spacing, and hierarchy around the meaning and priorities of each piece—rather than applying one template to everything. In English, that starts by asking whether the words are there to be read, used or seen—and which house style they follow.
en.features_deck: Practical priorities for creating and reviewing English content.

features.p: Latin script is not only English, and a region is not a house style, so script (Latn), language (en), region (en-US, en-GB, en-AU) and house style are recorded separately. The measure—line length—is set together with word spacing and hyphenation: left-aligned text by default on the web, justification only where each line is checked for rivers, and no break-all splitting ordinary words.

Shape the layout around the information, its priority, and the reader’s goal. Text to be read, used or seen is designed in different ways, and headline breaks follow meaning—“A busy day. / A quiet cup.”, not “A busy / day.” A single word left on a line may be intended emphasis, so alternatives are proposed rather than forced.

Protect names, quotations, numbers, dates, codes and intended meaning. Quotation marks, the serial comma, dates (October 20, 2026 or 20 October 2026) and spelling follow the chosen house style and are never silently switched to another region’s; names, quotations and code keep their own form. Figures are treated by type—a leading zero, a year or a currency is more than digits—and lining or oldstyle, proportional or tabular are separate choices.

Check finished work and organize issues—without touching the files. Hierarchy is not judged by size alone—IBM’s Carbon sets heading-01 and body-01 both at 14 px and separates them by weight—and output is checked at real widths, at 200% text and under WCAG text-spacing overrides. A pass covers only that browser, width and font.

en.idea_body: KUMIHAN｜Measure doesn't dictate a finished look. It gives AI the knowledge to adapt to each medium and brief. English has no single house style, and published values answer their own purpose: GOV.UK sets body text at 19 px, IBM’s Carbon at 14 px for product UI. Even the measure is a starting proposal—about 55–75 characters for long-form web text—where other guides give ranges of 45–90 or 75–120.

ja.status_body: v0.1.0（予定）は、完了した調査をもとに開発中です。4つのスキル（kumihan-measure・-web・-documents・-review、名称は仮）を計画していますが、ルールはまだ確定していません。調査では、英語の本文・広告・UI（en-USとen-GBを起点）と、日本語・中国語・韓国語との基本的な混植、右から左へ書く文字の挿入の安全性を初期の重点として提案しています。インド系・東南アジアの文字との調整や、ハイフネーションやオプティカルマージンなど書籍水準の組版は後の段階で、専門家のレビューが必要です。配布、ブラウザーでの表示、書体の選定は未検証で、このサイトの英語の文面は英語母語話者の編集者や組版の専門家による確認をまだ受けていません。
